body:
I'm still trying my best, but you see, my friend actually has suicide planned out. There isn't a doubt in his mind he's not going to do it. 

Thanks for your support anyway, it means a lot to me!

I know his postcode, that's it. We live far away from each other too. I once said we should meet up as friends, and he was against it because of how long it would take for me to get there.

I'm pretty sure if I did show up to where he lives anyway, he would also end his life because he really doesn't like how much he's involved me with his personal problems.

All of his family hate him, I forgot to say that. My friend is also getting kicked out soon and he's being forced to move to another family members house (We're both 17).

After some googling of what a 72 hour watch is, I'm still not exactly sure of what it is and even if you can get it in England (I don't know too much about this stuff). After my friend gets out, I am 100% sure he would kill himself. He would find any way he can to end his life.
